description: The methods this running app answers (names only).
name: rpc.methods

description: The app: its name, pid, frames drawn, window size in points, the framebuffer scale, and whether its window is visible.
name: app.info

description: The app's log since a cursor: pass the returned next_seq as since_seq to get only what is new. `dropped` > 0 means the ring wrapped and records were lost before they were read.
name: app.logs

since_seq.description: Return records with seq >= this (0: from the oldest kept).

description: Quits the app (as closing its window would); answers before it goes.
name: app.quit

description: Waits until the app has drawn this many more frames (default 1).
name: frame.wait

description: Every ImGui window and item drawn in the last frame: ref, window, label, rect [x, y, w, h] in window points, and state (checkable/checked, openable/opened, inputable, disabled, visible). Static text is not an item: use the app's own state methods or a screenshot to read it.
name: ui.snapshot

interactive_only.description: Only items that take input (default false).

window.description: Only items of this window (its name).

description: Resolves a target to one item (its ref, window, label, rect and state).
name: ui.find

target.description: An ImGui item: its ref from ui.snapshot ('#1a2b3c4d', stable while the item exists), 'Window/Label' (the window's name and the item's visible label), or a bare label. Matching nothing or more than one item is an error that lists the candidates.

description: A PNG of the next frame drawn: the whole window, an item's rect (target) or a rect in points. Returns png_base64, scale (image px per point), logical_rect [x, y, w, h] in points and image_size; an image pixel (px, py) is the point (logical_rect.x + px / scale, logical_rect.y + py / scale).
name: ui.screenshot

max_size.description: Downscale so the longer side is at most this many px (default 1600).

rect.description: [x, y, w, h] in window points.

target.description: An ImGui item: its ref from ui.snapshot ('#1a2b3c4d', stable while the item exists), 'Window/Label' (the window's name and the item's visible label), or a bare label. Matching nothing or more than one item is an error that lists the candidates.

description: Waits until an item exists (or is gone, or is enabled), checking each frame. Errors with `timeout` if it does not happen within timeout_ms.
name: ui.wait_for

target.description: An ImGui item: its ref from ui.snapshot ('#1a2b3c4d', stable while the item exists), 'Window/Label' (the window's name and the item's visible label), or a bare label. Matching nothing or more than one item is an error that lists the candidates.

description: Clicks an item (at its centre, or at x, y within it) or a point in the window. Synthesised through ImGui's input queue, so it reaches the 3D view as well as widgets.
name: input.click

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held during the action (alt = Option, super = Cmd).

target.description: An ImGui item: its ref from ui.snapshot ('#1a2b3c4d', stable while the item exists), 'Window/Label' (the window's name and the item's visible label), or a bare label. Matching nothing or more than one item is an error that lists the candidates.

x.description: Window points (with a target: points from the item's top left).

y.description: Window points (with a target: points from the item's top left).

description: Moves the mouse to a point in the window (hover).
name: input.move

description: Presses at `from`, moves in steps to `to` and releases: orbiting (left) or panning (right) the 3D view, a slider, or with modifiers a lasso in the scanning app (shift: select).
name: input.drag

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held during the action (alt = Option, super = Cmd).

path.description: Instead of from/to: every [x, y] point of the drag in order (e.g. a lasso outline).

steps.description: Intermediate moves between from and to (default 12).

description: Scrolls the mouse wheel at a point (zooms the 3D view).
name: input.scroll

dy.description: Vertical wheel steps (positive: up / zoom in).

x.description: Window points (default: where the mouse is).

y.description: Window points (default: where the mouse is).

description: Presses and releases a key (ImGui key names: 'Escape', 'Delete', 'Backspace', 'Enter', 'Z', 'Space', 'F1', ...).
name: input.key

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held during the action (alt = Option, super = Cmd).

description: Types text into the focused text field.
name: input.type

description: Everything about the scanning app now: connection, workflow step and scan type, whether it is scanning, the HUD (tracking, fps, frames, model points, markers, distance), the recording, processing, editing and view state.
name: scan.state

description: Connects the scanner over USB, or the built-in emulator (a simulated scanner and scene, no hardware).
name: device.connect

emulator.description: Use the emulator instead of a scanner.

description: Disconnects (stops scanning).
name: device.disconnect

description: Opens a workflow step (as clicking its header). Not while scanning.
name: workflow.goto

description: The scan type: hybrid (surface + markers, the default), surface (shape only) or global_markers (capture and optimise a marker map first). Not while scanning.
name: scan.set_type

description: Starts or resumes scanning (opens the scan step).
name: scan.start

description: Pauses scanning; the model and recording are kept.
name: scan.pause

description: A new scan: clears the model and starts a new recording.
name: scan.new

discard.description: Delete the current recording (default false: it is kept).

description: Reads, and with any field given changes, the scanner's settings.
name: scan.settings

description: Bundle-adjusts the captured global markers into a fixed map (markers step, paused).
name: markers.optimize

description: Discards the global markers (and their map).
name: markers.clear

description: Saves the global-marker map.
name: markers.save

description: Loads a global-marker map.
name: markers.load

description: Processes the recorded scan into a mesh (in the background; poll process.status). Not while scanning.
name: process.run

description: Processing: running, stage, fraction, done, summary.
name: process.status

description: Cancels processing.
name: process.cancel

description: Exports the processed mesh (.stl, .ply or .obj by extension).
name: process.export

description: The 3D view's camera (target, distance, orientation as a quaternion [w, x, y, z], eye, forward) and options.
name: view.get

description: Moves the 3D view's camera (leaves follow mode) and/or changes its options. Orientation takes camera axes (x right, y down, z forward) to world axes.
name: view.set

orbit.description: [dx, dy] radians, as a left-drag would.

reset.description: Back to the default view first.

description: Adds a lasso stroke to the selection (paused scans): a polygon in window points, as seen in the current view; everything inside it, front to back, is selected (subtract: removed from the selection).
name: edit.select

description: Clears the selection.
name: edit.clear

description: Deletes the selection from the live model and the recording (processing never sees it); undoable until scanning resumes. Answers once done.
name: edit.delete

description: Undoes the last delete. Answers once done.
name: edit.undo

description: Selection strokes, undoable deletes, the last message.
name: edit.status

description: The calibration app now: connection, the 25-view plan with what is captured, the active group, the live view (distance, tilts, roll, offset, hints, whether in position and steady), lighting, and the solve.
name: calib.state

description: Connects the scanner, or the emulator (a simulated scanner and board).
name: calib.connect

description: Disconnects.
name: calib.disconnect

description: Selects the orientation group to capture next: 0 face-on, 1 top edge near, 2 bottom edge near, 3 right edge near, 4 left edge near.
name: calib.group

description: Turns capturing automatically when steady on or off.
name: calib.auto_capture

description: Captures the current view now (as the Capture now button).
name: calib.capture

description: Clears one capture, or all of them (a new session).
name: calib.clear

description: Loads a folder of captures (imageLeftN / imageRightN).
name: calib.load_folder

description: Loads a reference calibration to compare with.
name: calib.load_reference

description: Solves the stereo calibration from the captures (background; poll calib.state).
name: calib.solve

description: Saves the solved calibration (returns the path).
name: calib.save

description: What writing to the scanner would do: the gates (all must pass), the backup path.
name: calib.plan_write

description: Writes the solved calibration into the scanner's flash (stream paused, current pages backed up first, read back and verified). Real hardware: this replaces the scanner's calibration.
name: calib.write

description: Puts a calibration backup back into the scanner's flash.
name: calib.restore

description: Reads, and with any field given changes, the lighting.
name: calib.lighting

description: Shows a tab of the main view.
name: calib.tab
